name: War-Awoken Lunar Efflorescence (Weapon Skill)
effects: One single attack (11.00 or 66.00 each) capped at 199,999 based on ATK and MAG. Grants [Water, Fire, Lightning Damage Cap +20000 (Tactical)], [Water, Fire, Lightning Ability DEF and RES 30% Piercing (Tactical)], [Instant ATB 1], [Instant Cast 1] to user, grants [Tactical Chase Mode: Edge] to user if Level 2+ EnWater or EnFire or EnLightning, grants [Attach Water 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Fire 2 with Stacking]/[Attach Lightning 2 with Stacking] to user if not.
